project_info.theme: long-exposure fashion portrait with ghosted motion silhouettes
project_info.color_palette: near black, deep brown, warm amber gold, muted skin tone

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with a short tousled brown bob, understated dramatic makeup, and a long dark draped dress with opaque soft fabric.
main_subject.style: cinematic luxury fashion editorial with natural skin texture

items: sharp central three-quarter portrait against a near-black studio
two soft translucent-looking motion echoes created by the same subject moving on either side
long dark draped dress with a high-fashion silhouette
subtle warm halo behind the central head and shoulders

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: warm tungsten key at approximately 3000K with soft side fill and controlled volumetric haze
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: amber highlights, soft shadows, long-exposure ghosting, and an intimate surreal atmosphere

technical_specs.render_style: 85mm lens at f/2, long-exposure composite, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, natural vignetting

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic fashion portrait of an adult woman in a long dark draped dress with soft opaque fabric, short tousled brown hair, natural glowing skin, and understated dramatic makeup, standing in a dark moody studio. Create motion-blur ghost figures from her movement around a sharp central pose to form a surreal double-exposure effect. Use warm golden lighting, a dreamy atmosphere, long-exposure photography, shallow depth of field, soft shadows, a luxury fashion-editorial aesthetic, fine film grain, an 85mm lens, and restrained volumetric light. Keep the central subject clear, the motion echoes soft, and do not render a watermark or text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, watermark, logo, text, duplicate unrelated people, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: All assets are optional. Preserve the adult subject, dark opaque draped dress, sharp central portrait, warm low-key studio, and same-subject motion echoes. Wardrobe and echo shape can be replaced independently.
